title: AI Automation for Beginners: How to Set Up Your First Workflow in 30 Minutes
author: Malaclyde
excerpt: A practical 40-page guide showing small business owners how to set up AI automation workflows in 30 minutes. No technical background required.
content:
Most small business owners know they should be using AI automation. But between running the business, serving clients, and managing operations, who has time to figure it out?

The AI Automation for Beginners Guide solves this. It's a 40-page practical guide that walks you through setting up your first AI workflow in 30 minutes — with no technical background required.

What You'll Learn

  • Why AI automation matters in 2026
  • How to choose the right tools for your needs
  • Step-by-step setup for your first workflow
  • Real-world use cases and examples
  • Common mistakes to avoid
  • How to scale your automations

Includes

  • 40-page comprehensive guide
  • Tool comparison cheat sheet
  • Workflow templates
  • Resource list with free tools

Get the Guide →
